messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: Nimbus Health shows rising churn signals (low feature usage + billing questions). Request from AE: run a short hands-on enablement to unblock integration and surface value. Can we do two compact lab sessions: one for EU mornings CET and one for APAC-friendly SGT?
Samir (AE): Agree. Keep it practical — 60	60m lab with live troubleshooting. No slide decks please.
Jules (Solutions): We can offer a repo walkthrough + pairing on their infra. Availability: Wed 09:00 CET and Thu 08:30 SGT.
Aisha (Enablement): I can facilitate the SGT slot. Need a co-host for the CET slot to cover model/serving config.
Maya (CS): Samir, can you co-host CET? Customer prefers weekday mornings CET.
Samir (AE): I can take CET if I get a short migration checklist and a failure-mode demo (network + auth). Paste snippet of commands we plan to run?
Jules (Solutions): Runbook excerpt (paste into chat):
```
# Quick preflight
1) export RW_API_KEY=<redacted>
2) curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions -d '{"mode":"dedicated","region":"eu-central-1"}'
3) git clone git@github.com:redwood/demo-playbooks.git && cd demo-playbooks/nimbus
4) python smoke_test.py --prompts sample_prompts.json --model redwood/fast-13b
```
Troubleshooting tips: check VPC peering, KMS policy, and client IP allowlist.
Aisha (Enablement): Proposed agenda: 1) 10m context + success metrics, 2) 45m hands-on runbook pairing, 3) 20m failure-mode drills, 4) 15m feedback & next steps. Keep a short feedback form at the end.
Samir (AE): I'll ask their SRE to join. Also will create a Doodle for exact customer times and confirm CET preference.
Maya (CS): Can we capture success criteria for renewal note? Suggest: a) successful ingest + 10 sample prompts, b) median p50 latency <1.2s on a 1k token run, c) walkthrough recorded and 1-page exec summary.
Jules (Solutions): I'll prepare a minimal demo dataset and a condensed exec-summary template for recording highlights.
Aisha (Enablement): Recording: yes, with short clips for execs. I'll attach the feedback form and runbook to the invite. Emoji check: :thumbsup: ?
Samir (AE): :thumbsup: Also add a step to validate model pins and quantization profile.
OncallBot: Note: No scheduled infra maintenance during proposed windows.
Maya (CS): Action items: Samir -> Doodle + SRE invite; Aisha -> calendar invites + feedback form + record consent; Jules -> demo repo + runbook; Maya -> add renewal playbook bullet points to the invite. Please confirm availability by EOD so I can send invites to the customer.
Jules (Solutions): Confirmed.
Samir (AE): Confirmed, will ping SRE and share the failure-mode slides (short).
Aisha (Enablement): Confirmed, drafting invites now.
Maya (CS): Thanks team 1 will update the renewal tracker once invites go out.
